title: Prove E8 span inputs over every odd-characteristic field (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with an exhaustive finite integer certificate. E8's orthogonal-complement span facts S1, S2, S3prime and projected-direction fact W2 hold over every field of characteristic different from two. There is no exceptional odd prime. This answers the finite-span part of DreamingOfClouds's PR2819 section 7 positive-characteristic boundary. No new kappa is claimed.

```text
standard doubled E8 roots
  -> 6539 exact power-of-two minors
  -> fixed-anchor span and projected-direction statements
  -> integral reflections transport them to every anchor
```

The existing characteristic-zero classification, SAT results and sign logic remain credited to DreamingOfClouds and the PR2784 lineage. They were not audited or replayed. CubeJerry/PR3095 and conorholds/PR3755 retain credit for power-of-two-minor and integral-reflection methods on different root/character span questions. The new result and complete certificate were produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence

Before this contribution, the cited classification explicitly excludes positive characteristic. The new verifier certifies the four stated span inputs in every odd characteristic using integer determinants, rather than extrapolating from tested primes.

- 6539 exact minors, each with absolute determinant in {2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256}; all 3276 projected-direction triples are included.
- 14400 root-reflection images and a complete 120-line orbit.
- 673 independent Leibniz determinant comparisons, three singular/odd-torsion rejection cases, and two dyadic-unit/power controls.
- Registered normal and optimized replays pass. Each registered command was timed locally: 0.13 and 0.14 seconds, below its 60-second limit. CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library only.
- Committed-byte/mode/source-history preflight passes at `2a804fcb32f46d66018185194b55f1f2b217523d` for ten package/input files. Source base is canonical main `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`.
- Official committed export and declared-input coverage pass. Normal and optimized Git-free replays with an empty PATH and read-only files emit identical complete JSON receipts; all eleven exported file hashes and modes remain unchanged. An altered source byte is rejected under optimization.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -I -B research/e8-odd-characteristic-spans/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -I -O -B research/e8-odd-characteristic-spans/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-odd-characteristic-spans
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/e8-odd-characteristic-spans --check-source-history
```

Expected markers: `PASS_E8_ODD_CHARACTERISTIC_SPANS`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The verifier writes its file-hash-bound receipt to stdout and writes no files. Certificate digest: `dd0ae76b8aa2f4e98287231bf2b803e4ad25fd137151143f385d6de61ac133bf`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The complete rank-nine classification in positive characteristic is not proved here. Remaining pinning implications, sign logic, other finite facts and SAT obligations need their own field-scope argument. No native supplier, physical caller, decoder floor, complete signed invoice, frontier update or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. The five selected framework assumptions remain. No historical supplier replay, Lean, Docker, independent human review or formal proof-kernel check ran.

## Open next questions

- Determine the characteristic assumptions of the remaining PR2819 classification implications. Start by listing their field operations and denominators; the new span inputs alone do not settle them.
- Identify an explicitly missing P112/P104 span proposition and test whether dyadic-unit minors can supply its field transfer. A distinct incidence domain and valid target must be specified first.

## Related open work

- #3040 studies E8 rank-eight rigidity after small deletions; this contribution supplies four span facts over a new field range and does not extend that rigidity theorem.
- #3045 studies square root-code COPY floors for arbitrary fitting binary pairings; this contribution proves no COPY floor and does not import its computations.
- #2832 reduces general E8 decoder questions and records the rank-nine classification; this contribution extends only the named finite span inputs.
- #3074 gives P112-to-P120 decoder padding; this contribution changes a geometric lemma's field scope and does not alter its padding construction.
- #3154 organizes conjectural P112/E8 floor reductions; no conjecture in that programme is claimed closed here.
- #1931 constructs an involutive E8 source interface; the reflections here transport a root configuration in a proof and supply no paid native interface.
- #647 studies an exact-RAM E8 realization; this contribution gives no RAM or tape realization and no rate comparison.

No shared numerical quantity is recomputed to assess those PRs. The post-CI refresh found no additional open PR studying these four E8 span inputs and no new shared numerical quantity requiring comparison. Sparse local-note coverage and unpublished work remain limitations.

## CI notes

Hosted CI passes at `2a804fcb32f46d66018185194b55f1f2b217523d` in [run 40911839389](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40911839389): `plan` and `replay (research/e8-odd-characteristic-spans)` both succeeded. The completed checks were read once and the run head was confirmed. Hosted replay certifies the registered normal and optimized certificate commands; it is not independent mathematical acceptance or a proof-kernel check. All local evidence above remains applicable.

## Merge Danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: isolated. Only the new research package is added; selected construction files and predecessor evidence are untouched.
